text:
Thank you for writing to the Companion Animal Travel Desk of Aurelia Skyways, and for taking the time to share what happened with your pet, Peanut.

You reported that a travel disruption led to your missed connection, and that the resulting delay and uncertainty were stressful for your animal and for you.

For missed connection, the standard payout is $125.

Here is what we do on the ground to keep incidents like this as rare and as calm as possible. Aurelia Skyways carries passengers between skyports, and our animal-handling team follows a calm, humane approach designed to reduce confusion for companion animals. Before departure, the senior coordinator confirms the required travel steps with the handler team, including the exact handoff points, carrier handling expectations, and comfort checks that match the species and temperament on the manifest. If weather, gate changes, or operational constraints interfere with a connection, the passenger coordinator escalates to re-route and re-sequence plans with the least disruption to your pet’s routine and breathing comfort.

When a missed connection occurs, we review whether there was any preventable breakdown in the coordination chain, including timing between skyport points and whether the handler received the latest updates early enough. We also verify that the companion travel plan remained consistent for your pet’s needs, such as water access, shade and airflow considerations, and gentle handling during transitions.

To support your case, please keep any boarding pass or receipt you have, along with the contact details you used for travel. Once our team confirms the connection disruption and your companion travel status, the payout will be processed according to our missed-connection policy, and you will receive confirmation of the outcome.

We appreciate your patience, and we will use your feedback to improve the next coordination step.  
Companion Animal Travel Desk
